title: Table configuration v2
description: Table polygons captured per camera in normalised frame coordinates (0..1). Version 1 used pixels and is intentionally rejected; it must be migrated by hand.

version.description: Only the normalised-coordinate contract is accepted. version 1 stored pixel coordinates and must be migrated by hand, never converted automatically.

tables.description: Table order is irrelevant. Ids must be unique; JSON Schema cannot express that, so the loaders enforce it.

video.description: Reference frame of the preview. Pixel size is a display hint only; geometry uses normalised coordinates.

aspect_ratio.description: Calibration guard such as 16:9. The live stream must be an exact multiple of this ratio.

pixelDimension.description: Positive pixel count. The upper bound is the Kotlin Int ceiling, which is also the widest frame both runtimes can represent.

label.description: Optional display name. Blank or missing labels fall back to the id at runtime.

polygon.description: Footprint in normalised coordinates. Self-intersection and the minimum area (0.0005) are runtime rules, not representable here.

tableId.description: Stable identifier shared with the server. Uniqueness is enforced by the loaders.

unit.description: Normalised axis value. NaN and Infinity cannot be represented in JSON.
